class.name: FoxCharacterPoseManager
class.brief_description: Component that manages the character's macro human configuration.
class.description: Acts as the definitive source of truth for the character's physical shape and visual stance. Resolves player intents against physical constraints, and allows specialized physics states to lock custom poses.

method.name: resolve_pose
method.description: Resolves intents and physical constraints to determine the correct locomotion pose. Requires the current [param is_grounded] context from the active state.

method.name: is_standing
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the character is currently in the [constant Type.STANDING] pose.

method.name: request_crouch
method.description: Registers an intent to crouch during standard locomotion.

method.name: is_crouching
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the character is currently in the [constant Type.CROUCHING] pose.

method.name: request_prone
method.description: Registers an intent to go prone during standard locomotion.

method.name: lock_pose
method.description: Forces the manager into a specific pose, bypassing standard [method resolve_pose] rules.

method.name: unlock_pose
method.description: Releases a previously locked pose, returning control to standard evaluation.

method.name: get_current_speed_limit
method.description: Returns the appropriate maximum speed limit for the currently active pose.

method.name: can_stand_up
method.description: Casts the headroom sensor upward to ensure clearance for standing.

members.member: The sensor used to detect if a ceiling blocks the character from standing.
The maximum grounded speed when the character is standing.
The maximum grounded speed when the character is crouching.
The maximum grounded speed when the character is prone.

signal.name: pose_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the active pose changes. The character facade routes this to the visual model, collision hitbox, and camera pivot.
